# JSON for Modern C++

Unmodified single header and MIT license from nlohmann/json **v3.12.0**.

- Release: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0
- Header: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/LICENSE.MIT
- `json.hpp` SHA-256 (matches the published release): `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`
- `LICENSE.MIT` SHA-256: `46a65cffd1ea955132d95a8dd921640714a8d6b537d2e4e482d31145ae95b603`

Used privately by `paths_content` for JSON syntax. No network fetch is needed
at configure or build time, and the runtime question model does not depend on it.
